subject: Initiative ramp plan & owner commitments — Novologix (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amrita Shah <amrita.shah@novologix.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@novologix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initiative ramp plan & owner commitments — Novologix (post-call recap)

Hi Amrita / Devon —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed landing plan so we can keep momentum and align stakeholders. I captured the pain, goals, and suggested first milestones below.

Key pain points you shared
- Production latency spikes (tail latency during peak inference) causing poor user experience on mobile.
- Cost volatility with current vendor (token billing unpredictability + poor batching).
- Security requirement: data residency in US regions and SOC2 evidence for audit.
- Integration friction: existing microservice uses streaming and expects sub-200ms token turn time.

Goals you outlined
1) Stable P95 latency under 250ms for typical queries during peak traffic.
2) Reduce per-session inference cost by 30% within pilot timeframe.
3) Complete security questionnaire and proof-of-controls within 3 weeks so procurement can start legal/financial review.

Proposed Mutual Success Plan (high level) — next milestones
- Week 0 (this week): Share MPA draft + SOW for review (owner: Rachel) — target: 2027-05-20
- Week 1: PoC infra & test harness up; baseline performance metrics collected (owner: Karthik) — target: 2027-05-27
- Week 2: Security questionnaire submission and SOC2 evidence handoff (owner: Monica) — target: 2027-06-02
- Week 3: Integration performance test, cost tuning & quantization recommendations (owner: Karthik) — target: 2027-06-09
- Week 4: Exec review and procurement kickoff (owner: Amrita / Devon) — target: 2027-06-16

Open questions where we need your input
- Which region(s) do you need the data residency enforced in? You mentioned US-East primarily — please confirm.
- Any existing SSO/KMS constraints we should know for the PoC?

Next steps
- I’ll send the Mutual Success Plan (MPA) + a draft SOW by EOD tomorrow for your review.
- Karthik will follow up to schedule a short infra kickoff to collect sample traffic and identify integration points.

Attachments anticipated: MPA draft + SOW (stubs to follow).

If that all looks right to you, I’ll treat Week 0 as green and schedule the infra call. Thanks again — excited to get started.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Amrita Shah <amrita.shah@novologix.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@novologix.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiative ramp plan & owner commitments — Novologix (post-call recap)

Thanks Rachel — this is very helpful. A few quick clarifications: 

- Data residency: yes, US-East required for production; for the PoC US-West is ok if that speeds setup but prefer East for final tests.
- SSO/KMS: we use Okta for SSO and AWS KMS CMKs for secrets — Monica on our side will coordinate with you.
- Exec timing: exec review will likely happen the week of 6/14; procurement needs the SOW + security answers by 6/9 to stay on pace.

On the PoC scope, can we limit initial test traffic to the fraud-detection model (20–30k tokens/day) rather than full production corpora? That will make it easier for us to approve access.

We’ll review the MPA once you send it tomorrow. Otherwise green to proceed with the infra call — Devon will pick a couple of windows.

Thanks,
Amrita
VP Product | Novologix
Amrita.Shah@novologix.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Per our timeline, attached is a first-pass "Mutual Success Plan (v1)" and a draft SOW. High-level summary of what’s in the MPA:

- Objective: Demonstrate consistent P95 latency <250ms and 30% cost reduction compared to current vendor in a 4-week PoC focused on fraud-detection workload.
- Success metrics: P50/P95/P99 latency, tokens-per-inference cost, request throughput, and integration stability.
- Responsibilities: Owner matrix with names (Rachel, Karthik, Monica, Amrita, Devon) and clear deliverables.
- Security: SOC2 evidence checklist + requested logs/audit format.
- Milestones & dates: same as email plus a contingency window for procurement.
